newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak President names new Foreign Minister.
newsitem.headline: Slovak President names new Foreign Minister.

text.p: Slovak President Michal Kovac accepted a government proposal on Wednesday to name Zdenka Kramplova as the new Foreign Minister, a statement from the president's office said.

Presidential spokesman Vladimir Stefko said the relatively unknown Kramplova, the first women to hold the position, had been a senior civil servant in the Foreign Ministry and was head of the government office until January.
Kovac will officially appoint Kramplova, who is 40, to the post on June 11.
Kramplova replaces Pavol Hamzik who resigned on May 26 because of the domestic political situation and failed referendums on NATO membership and direct presidential elections.
